name: @tnzi/ui-monorepo
description: Tnzi.NET Frontend Packages Monorepo - core, ui, ui-admin, ai, mobile.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @tnzi/core build && pnpm --filter @tnzi/ui build && pnpm --filter @tnzi/ui-ai build && pnpm --filter @tnzi/ui-admin build && pnpm --filter @tnzi/mobile build
scripts.lint: eslint packages/ui/src packages/ui-admin/src packages/ui-ai/src packages/core/src packages/mobile/src
scripts.lint:fix: eslint packages/ui/src packages/ui-admin/src packages/ui-ai/src packages/core/src packages/mobile/src --fix
scripts.size: pnpm -F @tnzi/ui exec size-limit && pnpm -F @tnzi/ui-admin exec size-limit && pnpm -F @tnzi/ui-ai exec size-limit
scripts.codegen:status: node -e "console.log('NOT WIRED UP. packages/core/src/services is hand-written. codegen needs both src/Tnzi.UI/openapi.json and a repo-root tnzi.json; neither exists, so these scripts have never run here. Contract drift is checked by FrontendBackendContractTests (tests/Tnzi.Architecture.Tests) instead. See docs/coding-standards/frontend-api-contract.md')"
